dimensions.question: Are root and recovery keys generated, held and used under Egypt-controlled HSM and quorum procedures?
Can authentication, authorization and PAM decisions continue locally without a foreign control plane?
Are identity, session, biometric and audit data flows locally controlled and independently observable?
Can critical operations, revocation and break-glass function during external network isolation?
Are vendor support paths disabled by default and activated through scoped, recorded, time-limited approval?
Are artifacts pinned, signed, scanned, staged and supported by SBOM and rollback evidence?
Can identities, policies, evidence and secrets metadata be exported and restored to a replacement implementation?
Can an Egyptian operations team rebuild, recover and audit the platform without vendor intervention?
